name: walkie
description: Push-to-talk to Claude Code from any app: a held key records, a local Whisper transcribes, the mod submits the words and the answer is read aloud

folder.title: Exchange folder
folder.description: Where walkie.py drops transcripts and the mod leaves replies. Empty = ~/.claude/walkie.

pollMs.title: Poll every (ms)
pollMs.description: How often the drop folder is checked for a new transcript. Minimum 100.

asUser.title: Submit as your own words
asUser.description: Send each transcript as if you typed it, without the 'plugin sent a message' frame.

speakReplies.title: Read replies aloud
speakReplies.description: Write Claude's answer to the replies folder so walkie.py speaks it.

hint.title: Hint added to each voice prompt
hint.description: Appended in parentheses after the transcript so the answer suits being read aloud. Empty for none.
hint.default: Spoken over push-to-talk while I am away from the keyboard. Keep the reply short and plain: it is read aloud.

autoStart.title: Start the recorder
autoStart.description: The session that answers the drops starts walkie.py itself when no recorder is alive, and it ends with that session.

python.title: Python executable
python.description: What runs walkie.py: a name on PATH or a full path, spelled with .exe on Windows.

recorderArgs.title: Recorder arguments
recorderArgs.description: Extra flags for walkie.py, for example --key f14 --model small --no-speak.
